statement: The three claimed distinctions are weaker than the critique assumed. Distinction (iii) (validity/as-of rather than recency) is conceptually pre-empted: legal retrieval already frames the requirement as bitemporal valid-time correctness, and a legal RAG system already filters sources by temporal validity. Distinction (ii) (legal benchmark with temporal validity) is partially occupied by a legal benchmark encoding temporal validity, though not at version/passage granularity. Only distinction (i) (a post-hoc re-ranking term demonstrated across arbitrary base retrievers) remains untested, and even its framing is anticipated by the 'architecture-agnostic' pathology framing. Consequently the defensible delta narrows further, to version-level retrieval evaluation over near-duplicate amended clauses with a contamination metric plus the cross-retriever demonstration.
